page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 2.67 GB per vCPU.

This server type does not include any local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance, and there are no integrated graphics processing units on this hardware profile.

The high density of dedicated Intel Xeon compute cores relative to memory makes this instance type suitable for compute-heavy workloads. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized processing tasks that do not require massive per-core memory allocations or local storage. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, large-scale batch processing, and distributed simulation environments.
